conf.description: printers-mfd windows-print-jobs dataset, windows-event format: hand-built positional Param1..Param8 decode of PrintService events 307/800/805 (mechanism cribl-pipeline, no stock integration exists); real parsing per recommendations.direct.cribl.

conf.comment: printers-mfd / windows-print-jobs / windows-event: PrintService/Operational events 307/800/805, JSON-shaped (EventID, Param1..Param8, Status, Computer, ProviderName, TimeCreated.SystemTime, Message). No Elastic integration or Cribl pack decodes this channel's opaque Params, so this is a hand-built decode per the map's parsing notes. Param7=bytes, Param8=pages (commonly transposed elsewhere; kept distinct here). Param2 (job name) renders as the constant 'Print Document' unless the print server's 'Allow job name in event logs' policy is enabled -- the largest audit gap in this feed, not detectable from the record itself, so left uncorrected. Per recommendations.direct.cribl, decode runs in the core worker group; its Param5/Param6-to-device/site/owner lookup enrichment is NOT implemented here (no lookup table data supplied in the work order) -- documented gap, see README.

functions.description: record parsing scope, known gaps, and which recommendation was followed
decode the Windows Event Log JSON representation of the PrintService event
batch-rename the straight-copy status:mapped/partial fields to their ECS targets
split user.name's DOMAIN\user prefix, strip source.domain's leading UNC backslashes, and route the five unmapped Params/Status to their mfd.print.* custom targets
set Cribl's canonical event time from the print server's own event timestamp (never write @timestamp directly)
tag the event with its dataset (no hyphens, per the Elastic data-stream naming constraint)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
